reviews.title: Close remaining AS1/AS2 compiler and runtime gaps and promote all 527 AS2 APIs to Working
reviews.summary: Implements AS1/AS2 delete <identifier>, AS2 1-arg ClassName(expr) type casts, iterative if/else-if chains, MovieClip/XMLNode/prototype for..in enumeration, nested MovieClip scene jumps, Button enabled state reset, TextFormat justify and range setTextFormat/getTextFormat, streaming Sound and stop(id), NetStream/SharedObject/PrintJob/MovieClipLoader/FileReference/System.onStatus edge cases.
